column4: You made a party. Now post it.
Group one. Group two. Group eighty-seven.
Wherever Israelis party, Tel Aviv, Rhodes, Athens, Paris, they find you.
Wawg. Your party, everywhere Israelis go.
Monday, Moshe's bar. Wednesday, David's rooftop. Saturday, somewhere in Rhodes.
Fans follow you once, on Wawg.
Play anywhere. Wawg shows you to everyone nearby.
And your fans get tickets first.
